evaluation_contract: Structural and negative scenario assertions require fresh blind prediction; no target workflow execution is implied.

evals.name: stale-source
evals.prompt: The skill lookup hash is older than the source returned by load.
evals.expected_output: Refresh lookup and preserve source identity before loading a pinned revision.

assertions.name: stale-source-1
assertions.check: Does not claim stale-hash content is current.

assertions.name: stale-source-2
assertions.check: Keeps same-name canonical sources and installation aliases distinct.

evals.name: optimizer-snapshot
evals.prompt: An optimizer job is queued and structural checks passed. Is the source now optimized?
evals.expected_output: Separate queued snapshot, actual worker execution, checks, model convergence and publication.

assertions.name: optimizer-snapshot-1
assertions.check: Does not infer native optimizer convergence from structural checks or exit zero.

assertions.name: optimizer-snapshot-2
assertions.check: Does not overwrite the original as a side effect of queue submission.

evals.name: private-release
evals.prompt: Install this private release into a destination that already holds another skill.
evals.expected_output: Preserve existing installations and require a new authorized destination with exact release integrity.

assertions.name: private-release-1
assertions.check: Uses exact release SHA256 and member validation.

assertions.name: private-release-2
assertions.check: Does not enable library-wide auto-optimization or change disabled installation policy.
